sloka: ततो बाणमयं वर्षं नीलस्योरस्यपातयत्।गिरौ वर्षं तडिच्चक्रचापवानिव तोयदः ।। ६.७०.२९ ।।
transliteration: tato bāṇamayaṁ varṣaṁ nīlasyorasyapātayat।girau varṣaṁ taḍiccakracāpavāniva toyadaḥ ।। 6.70.29 ।।

translations.english: Mahodara got enraged, mounted on an elephant just as the Sun went over Mandara mountain and went for war. Then Mahodara wielding bow rained arrows, just as rainy clouds with lightning and rainbows showers rain, on the mountain like chest of Neela.
